headline: Chicago Corn Futures Hit 4-Month Low on Abundant US Crop Outlook
summary: Chicago Board of Trade corn futures dropped to a four-month low while soybean prices hit a two-month low due to expectations of abundant US harvests and export demand concerns.
why: Agricultural commodity futures benchmark global food prices and directly affect revenue for agribusinesses, farm inputs, and consumer goods manufacturers.

impacts.name: Corn futures
impacts.why: Corn futures fell to a four-month low on Chicago Board of Trade.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of abundant US harvests and concerns over export demand caused Chicago corn futures to drop to a four-month low.
